g.text: TPS62130, 12 V input. 0.8 V reference x (1 + 43.7k/100k) = 1.1496 V.

g.desc: TPS62130, 12 V input. 0.8 V reference x (1 + 43.7k/100k) = 1.1496 V.

g.text: Hub VCORE allowed range 1.09-1.21 V. Hold HUB_RESET_N low until both hub rails are stable.

g.desc: Hub VCORE allowed range 1.09-1.21 V. Hold HUB_RESET_N low until both hub rails are stable.

g.text: Named nets connect the circuit blocks on this sheet and across the hierarchy.

g.desc: Named nets connect the circuit blocks on this sheet and across the hierarchy.

g.text: WEBENCH Design103 adapted for I2C (ADDR=GND, address 0x6A), internal feedback and MCU enable/reset.

g.desc: WEBENCH Design103 adapted for I2C (ADDR=GND, address 0x6A), internal feedback and MCU enable/reset.

g.text: APS1040M2R2A replaces 1.8 uH. Compensation and current limit require recalculation/testing before power-up.

g.desc: APS1040M2R2A replaces 1.8 uH. Compensation and current limit require recalculation/testing before power-up.

g.text: All bridge FETs standardized to CSD17577Q3A (30 V). Not an EPR design. Maximum contract 20 V / 5 A.

g.desc: All bridge FETs standardized to CSD17577Q3A (30 V). Not an EPR design. Maximum contract 20 V / 5 A.

g.text: WEBENCH Design104 values. EN intentionally floating per datasheet section 6.3.5.

g.desc: WEBENCH Design104 values. EN intentionally floating per datasheet section 6.3.5.

g.text: AGND/PGND join at regulator. Verify capacitance after DC-bias derating and inductor thermal limits.

g.desc: AGND/PGND join at regulator. Verify capacitance after DC-bias derating and inductor thermal limits.

g.text: WEBENCH Design105 topology and values; 1.2 MHz. MOSFET drain pad numbering follows TI NexFET land pattern.

g.desc: WEBENCH Design105 topology and values; 1.2 MHz. MOSFET drain pad numbering follows TI NexFET land pattern.

g.text: 5 V allocation: two Type-C ports at 3 A, USB-A SDP loads, plus VCONN/mux overhead. BC1.2 disabled.

g.desc: 5 V allocation: two Type-C ports at 3 A, USB-A SDP loads, plus VCONN/mux overhead. BC1.2 disabled.

g.text: Choose GPU pair OR EPS with a break-before-make selector rated >=30 A, >=24 VDC. Do not switch under load.

g.desc: Choose GPU pair OR EPS with a break-before-make selector rated >=30 A, >=24 VDC. Do not switch under load.

g.text: GPU pair MUST come from the same PSU. Both GPU connectors required for full output. Do not combine separate PSUs.

g.desc: GPU pair MUST come from the same PSU. Both GPU connectors required for full output. Do not combine separate PSUs.

g.text: Connector pin numbering is the electrical interface: verify keying, mating face and selected manufacturer drawing before layout.

g.desc: Connector pin numbering is the electrical interface: verify keying, mating face and selected manufacturer drawing before layout.

g.text: 12 V input - two GPU 8-pin OR one EPS 8-pin

g.desc: 12 V input - two GPU 8-pin OR one EPS 8-pin
